# CollegeGradez v1.0.0

The first stable release of CollegeGradez is a local-first Windows grade tracker
and GPA calculator.

## Highlights

- Track courses, assignments, grades, and credit-weighted GPA.
- Include previously taken courses in GPA and move eligible completed courses
  into course history.
- Customize grading policies and use weighted categories or total points.
- Export and import JSON backups; local saves also keep timestamped backups.
- Stable installations receive stable updates rather than prerelease updates.

## Before upgrading

Export a backup of your grade data before installing the update. The Windows
installer is unsigned, so Windows SmartScreen may show a warning. Download
only from this project's GitHub Releases page.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ethanluginbuhl/CollegeGradez/compare/v0.3.0-beta.1...v1.0.0
